English.Char_Desc_2000:
CaptionTool — Captions for Your Videos. Your Files Never Leave Your Computer.
Drop in a video or audio file. Get back caption-ready .srt and .vtt files, made entirely on your own computer. No upload, no account, no subscription. The program has no network code at all: your files never leave your machine.
What you get — one ready-to-use file for your system: - Windows: CaptionTool-Windows-x86_64.exe — double-click to run. - Mac (Apple silicon): CaptionTool-macOS-arm64.zip — unzip, drag the app into Applications. - Linux (Debian/Ubuntu): CaptionTool-Linux-x86_64.deb — install with your software centre or package manager.
Two modes: Accurate for the best captions it can make, and Fast draft when you want something quick to tidy up. On clean solo narration about 95 words in 100 come out exactly right in Accurate mode; noisier recordings need more tidying by hand. Captions are laid out to readable rules: short lines and a pace viewers can follow.
Worth knowing: English speech only in this version. The app is not signed with a paid developer certificate, so your system checks with you the first time you open it — on a Mac, open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway"; on Windows, click "More info" and then "Run anyway". After that it opens normally.
For comparison, the subscription caption services charge about this much every month. CaptionTool charges it once: £19.
